facts.value: California High School Proficiency Examination and other high school equivalency diplomas are recognized as high school diplomas
Course competency and aptitude requirements need to be satisfied for admission
Students should submit their diploma to show completion of high school
Students need to submit additional high school transcripts or SAT or ACT scores
Enrollment and successful completion of 24 semester credits with a minimum 2.75 GPA through Earned Admission may be used to satisfy admission requirements
Completion of 24 or more college credits from a regionally accredited college or university with a minimum cumulative GPA of 2.50 on a 4.00 scale may satisfy admission requirements
